claimAssessments.claim: 先生 is a respectful title for teachers and also certain experts/professionals.
claimAssessments.rationale: The dictionary lists teachers/instructors and specialists such as physicians, and records the honorific address use.

claimAssessments.claim: It follows a surname or is used alone as a vocative.
claimAssessments.rationale: The lexicon supports title/address functions but not all sentence patterns in the article.

claimAssessments.claim: It can substitute for third-person pronouns when referring to a known person.
claimAssessments.rationale: No primary syntax/pragmatics source was located for the substitution claim.

claimAssessments.claim: It is normally inappropriate to call oneself 先生.
claimAssessments.rationale: The consulted dictionary does not discuss self-reference; the broad rule remains unverified.
